mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_reconciliation_report_receipt(tenant_id,source_id,event_id,request_hash) VALUES(#{tenant},#{source},#{event},#{hash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_reconciliation_report_receipt.id
mapper.select: SELECT id,request_hash,case_no,accepted_at FROM tc_reconciliation_report_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_id=#{source} AND event_id=#{event} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_reconciliation_case(tenant_id,case_no,business_no,source_id,channel_id,statement_date,external_line_key,revision,difference_type,reference_type,business_ref,evidence_hash,evidence_ref,prior_case_no,content_hash,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{number},#{businessNo},#{source},#{report.channelId},#{report.statementDate},#{report.externalLineKey},#{report.revision},#{report.differenceType},#{report.referenceType},#{report.businessRef},#{report.evidenceHash},#{report.evidenceRef},#{report.priorCaseNo},#{hash},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_reconciliation_case.id
mapper.select: SELECT id,case_no,source_id,channel_id,statement_date,external_line_key,revision,difference_type,reference_type,business_ref,evidence_hash,evidence_ref,prior_case_no,content_hash,status,version,created_at,business_no FROM tc_reconciliation_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_id=#{source} AND channel_id=#{report.channelId} AND statement_date=#{report.statementDate} AND external_line_key=#{report.externalLineKey} AND revision=#{report.revision} AND difference_type=#{report.differenceType} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,case_no,source_id,channel_id,statement_date,external_line_key,revision,difference_type,reference_type,business_ref,evidence_hash,evidence_ref,prior_case_no,content_hash,status,version,created_at,business_no FROM tc_reconciliation_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND business_no=#{number}case_no=#{number}
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_reconciliation_report_receipt SET case_no=#{number},accepted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND case_no IS NULL
mapper.sql: FROM tc_reconciliation_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status=#{state} AND business_no=#{number}case_no=#{number}
mapper.select: SELECT id,case_no,source_id,channel_id,statement_date,external_line_key,revision,difference_type,reference_type,business_ref,evidence_hash,evidence_ref,prior_case_no,content_hash,status,version,created_at,business_no AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id,case_no,source_id,channel_id,statement_date,external_line_key,revision,difference_type,reference_type,business_ref,evidence_hash,evidence_ref,prior_case_no,content_hash,status,version,created_at,business_no ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
